svg.text: Print the block, the arm walls and the hinge core as one part, slot upward

svg.text: Ream the 6.5 mm hinge bore; keep the bore clear below the clip

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold two triangular outrigger beams (50 mm sides) from 170 x 265 mm blanks; they lie square to the doorway

svg.text: Fits: the stub's end edge drops into the slot and the arm until the two pegs click into its lower holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two filled bags sit on the upstream outrigger; when the wall leans they lift with the stub

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lifting the stub end lifts the foot and both bags
